description:
Prowl Mirror is the companion app for Prowl, the free macOS app for running AI coding agents side by side. Pair your iPhone or iPad with Prowl on your Mac, and keep up with any agent running on it when you step away from the desk.

FOLLOW EVERY AGENT
• See every agent and terminal on your Mac, grouped by project as in Prowl's sidebar.
• Blocked, working and done at a glance, in the same colors as on the Mac.
• Read an agent's conversation as a clean chat with its messages, tool calls, diffs and command output, or switch to the live terminal screen.

ANSWER WHEN IT ASKS
• When an agent asks for permission or asks a question, the choices show as buttons. Tap one, and Prowl answers on your Mac.
• Send a follow-up message, stop an agent, or use the key bar for Escape, arrows, Tab and Return.

START NEW WORK
• Start a new session in any project with one of your Agent Profiles and a first message.

NOTIFICATIONS, PRIVATELY
• Optionally get a notification when an agent needs you or finishes while you are away from your Mac. The content is end-to-end encrypted, so only your device can read it.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• The app connects directly to your Mac over your local network or VPN, encrypted with a key created when you pair. No account, no analytics, no trackers.

WHAT YOU NEED
• A Mac running Prowl (free at prowl.cat) with Remote Mirror turned on.
• Your iPhone or iPad on the same network as the Mac, or connected to it over a VPN.

Not ready to pair? Tap "Try the Demo" to explore the app with sample agents.

Prowl Mirror is an independent app and is not affiliated with the makers of the agents it works with.
promotionalText: Your agents keep working while you step away. See what each one is doing on your Mac, and answer the moment one needs you.
